sources.made: The census columns (type, eras, default, observed, and the top-level eras, classes and encode_order) were merged by hand from brush_model.census_columns of a census of the library, read in memory with python -I: what `python -I brushes/pipeline/ingest.py census --json` prints under `columns`. Every other column is written by hand. No script writes this file.
sources.proof: With this file, every Brush.archive of the library was decoded to its JSON parameters and rebuilt from them and this file alone to the same bytes (tests/test_brush_model.py, the opt-in corpus test).
sources.unproven: No file written from this schema has been opened in Procreate. Labels, groups, enum meanings and limits are inferred; limits are slider ranges, never rules (limits_hard is false in every row).

ios_legacy.rule: A value string shares one object only when it is NSObject, NSArray, NSMutableArray or NSDate (keyed_archive.LEGACY_SHARED).

ios_modern.rule: An ASCII value string shares one object when it is short enough to be held in a pointer: up to 7 characters; up to 9 from the alphabet; up to 11 from its first 32 characters (keyed_archive.tagged_pointer_eligible).

eras.notes: Legacy, 52 keys: the oldest key set. No version key; the root class has no ValkyrieBrush.
Legacy, 61 keys: E0 with version, blendMode, dynamicsRenderType, previewSize and six more, without dynamicsGlazeType.
Legacy, 67 keys: E1c with blendGammaCorrect, shapeFilter, shapeFilterMode and textureFilterMode.
Legacy, 88 keys: E2 with the three pressure curves, the pencil taper and color jitter, without dynamicsPressureSpeed.
Legacy, 101 keys: E3 with extendedBlend, pressure smoothing and color pressure and tilt, without dynamicsColorVariation. The legacy era a new brush can be made in.
Modern, 172 keys. One archive (P2 Painting). Its strings follow the ios_legacy rule.
Modern, 173 keys: M172 with cloneSize and cloneOpacity, without paintPressure (Sweet Treats). Its strings follow the ios_legacy rule.
Modern, 220 keys, or 221 to 223 with optional pressure curves: the key orders of the ten key sets seen are its variants. The default era of a new brush.
Modern, 242 keys, version 4 (Earth, Chinese Calligraphy): M220 without paintPressure, with 23 more keys.

$class_entry.notes: The entry a `$class` names: its class name and class chain.

NSArray.notes: The saved... tool-state arrays. All empty arrays of one archive are one shared object.

NSDate.notes: NS.time is a 64-bit real: seconds since 2001-01-01.

NSMutableArray.notes: The points of a curve: an array of point strings.

NSMutableString.notes: A wrapped string; one archive stores its name this way.

ValkyrieBrushRollParameters.notes: Barrel-roll parameters: mode is an int, the three activation values 32-bit reals.

ValkyrieMagnitudinalCurve.notes: A pressure curve. Legacy curves hold resolution 1024 and modern ones none, in every archive seen.
